source_text: Memor delicti confiteatur quae commisit et medelam quaerat. Gloria Deo. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: Mindful of the fault let him confess what he committed and seek the cure. Glory to God. Amen.
pass_b_english: Remember the fall, confess it, seek the wound’s cure. Glory to God. Amen.
anf_compare: no ANF for Rufinus Ps 36–38; do not copy modern FOTC/SC
